name: tidyTIVI
description: One curated TiviMate backup, complete country logos, recipient credentials and Dropbox updates.
author: ayala

actions.label: Preview selected profiles
actions.description: Validate selected profiles and show only the EPG sources they use.

actions.label: Export combined backup
actions.description: Export all selected profiles together, with country logo folders and a companion update bundle.

actions.label: Export diagnostic job
actions.description: Write a private curation job for diagnosis. This JSON file is not a TiviMate backup.

actions.label: Connect Dropbox
actions.description: Start Dropbox sign-in; no app registration or tunnel required.

actions.label: Finish connection
actions.description: Complete sign-in using the one-time code saved in Settings.

actions.label: Cancel connection
actions.description: Cancel a pending sign-in; keep existing authorization.

actions.label: Dropbox status
actions.description: Show whether Dropbox authorization is saved.
